table.comment: User - Core user table for authentication, profile management, and access control

columns.comment: Authentication methods (basic, azure_ad) - supports multiple methods
Flag to force password change on next login
Whether the user account is active
Azure AD Object ID for SSO
Whether user is deleted from Azure AD
Timestamp until which account is locked

table.comment: UserActivityLog - Tracks all user-related actions for audit and security

columns.comment: Who performed the action (for admin actions)

table.comment: Position - Job positions available for recruitment

columns.comment: Whether position is open for applications

table.comment: Grade - Job grade levels with SLA and level configurations
PositionLevel - Position seniority levels (Entry, Junior, Mid, Senior, etc.)

columns.comment: Level name (e.g., Entry, Junior, Mid, Senior)

table.comment: Candidate - Job applicants and their application data
RecruitmentStage - Pipeline stages for candidate recruitment workflow

columns.comment: Whether this is a system-defined stage

table.comment: TransitionRecord - History of candidate stage transitions
LogEntry - General system and application logging
AuditLog - Security and compliance audit trail
UserGroup - User permission groups for role-based access control

columns.comment: Whether this is the default group
Whether this is a system-defined role

table.comment: UserTeam - Teams for organizing users within the organization
SystemSetting - Global application configuration settings
CustomFieldDefinition - Custom field schema definitions for extensible data models
CustomFieldOption - Predefined options for custom dropdown/select fields
JobMatch - AI-generated job matching results for candidates
UploadQueue - Queue for processing uploaded resume files
UserUIDisplayPreference - User-specific UI display preferences
Account - OAuth/external authentication provider accounts
SystemPreference - User-specific system preferences
CandidateComment - Comments and notes on candidate profiles
Attachment - File attachments for candidates and headcounts

columns.comment: Whether this is the primary attachment

table.comment: Webhook - Outbound webhook configurations for event notifications
WebhookBodyConfig - Custom body templates for webhook events
WebhookLog - Execution logs for webhook deliveries
Dashboard - Custom dashboard configurations for analytics
DashboardShare - Dashboard sharing permissions between users
DashboardWidget - Individual widgets within a dashboard
SystemPromptCategory - Categories for organizing AI system prompts
SystemPrompt - AI system prompts for various recruitment tasks
CandidateSource - Candidate sourcing channels (job portals, referrals, etc.)
Notification - User notification messages
Headcount - Position headcount tracking for workforce planning
PositionInterviewer - Interviewers assigned to positions
ExpertiseGroup - Groups of related expertise skills for evaluation
ExpertiseSkill - Individual expertise skills for candidate evaluation
PersonalityGroup - Groups of related personality traits for evaluation
PersonalityTrait - Individual personality traits for candidate evaluation
SkillTemplate - Reusable templates for skill and personality configurations
SkillTemplateGroup - Expertise group assignments in skill templates
SkillTemplateSkill - Expertise skill assignments in skill templates
SkillTemplatePersonalityGroup - Personality group assignments in skill templates
SkillTemplatePersonalityTrait - Personality trait assignments in skill templates
PositionExpertiseGroup - Expertise group requirements for positions
PositionExpertiseSkill - Expertise skill requirements for positions
PositionPersonalityGroup - Personality group requirements for positions
PositionPersonalityTrait - Personality trait requirements for positions
CandidateEvaluation - Evaluation records for candidate assessments
CandidateEvaluationLink - Secure links for external candidate evaluation

columns.comment: Whether login is required to access

table.comment: CandidateExpertiseScore - Recorded scores for expertise skills
CandidatePersonalityScore - Recorded scores for personality traits
User Session - tracks active sessions for single-device login enforcement
SystemApiKey - API keys for external system/service authentication (v2 API)

columns.comment: Display name for the API key
Optional description of the key's purpose
First 12 characters of the key for identification (e.g., "sk_live_abc1")
SHA-256 hash of the full API key
Whether the API key is active
Last time this key was used
IP address of last request using this key
Number of times this key has been used
User who created this API key
